name: midna_navi
author: marsh6487
description: Midna as Navi: Navi's draw is replaced by a Midna model when a Midna asset pack is installed (objects/midna_navi/...). Optional voice clips (custom/samples/midna_*) replace Navi's calls. Without the pack Navi is untouched. Port of marsh6487's Midna companion POC.
